app.name: Can Return?
app.tagline: Check if your drink container carries a 10¢ BCRS deposit

scan.privacyNote: All scanning happens on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
scan.privacyNoteIdentify: Image analysis runs on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
scan.privacyNoteDeposit: Deposit mark detection runs on your device. Nothing is uploaded.

package.takePhoto: Take a photo or use your camera to identify the container type
package.privacyNote: Image analysis runs entirely on your device using AI — nothing is uploaded.

depositMark.pointCamera: Point your camera at the Deposit Mark on the container — the circular logo with "10c SG Return"
depositMark.centreCircle: Centre the deposit mark in the circle
depositMark.aboutMark: The BCRS Deposit Mark is a circular logo with "10c SG Return" text, placed near the barcode.
depositMark.privacyNote: Detection runs entirely on your device — no image is uploaded.

eligibility.paylahSteps: Open the app → "My QR" → scan QR at the Return Right machine.
eligibility.ezlinkSteps: Tap your card at the machine reader.
eligibility.noPayment: This app does not process payments — bring your container to a machine to complete the return.

classification.eligibleNote: This packaging type ({{material}}) is eligible for BCRS — if it's between 150ml and 3L and carries a Deposit Mark.
classification.notEligibleNote: This packaging type ({{material}}) is <1>not covered</1> by BCRS. Only PET plastic, aluminium, and steel containers (150ml–3L) are eligible.
classification.note: This visual identification is a guide only. For a definitive eligibility check, scan the barcode on the container using the "Scan" tab. The AI identifies the packaging material, not whether the specific product is registered.

depositResult.aboutMark: BCRS-eligible containers carry a circular logo with "10c SG Return" text, placed within 10mm of the barcode. Standard size is ~11mm diameter.
depositResult.transitionNote: From 1 Oct 2026, all regulated beverages must carry this mark. During the transition period (Apr–Sep 2026), some eligible products may not have it yet.
depositResult.likelyEligible: This container is likely eligible for a 10¢ refund. Take it to any Return Right reverse vending machine. Use DBS PayLah! "My QR" or tap your EZ-Link/SimplyGo card to receive your deposit.
depositResult.noMarkNote: No mark doesn't always mean ineligible. During the transition period, some products are registered but haven't added the mark yet. Try scanning the barcode for a definitive check.

nearby.title: Nearby Return Points
nearby.subtitle: Find Return Right reverse vending machines near you
nearby.locationExplanation: Used only to find nearby return points and sort by distance. Your location is never stored or sent to any server.
nearby.locationDenied: Location permission denied. Use postal code instead.
nearby.locationError: Could not get location. Try postal code instead.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyNoticeDesc: What data is used and what stays on your device
settings.deleteDesc: Erases all cached scan history and return point data from this device. The eligibility database will be re-downloaded on next visit.
settings.dataCleared: All local data has been cleared.
settings.aboutText: Can Return? helps you check if a drink container carries a 10-cent deposit under Singapore's Beverage Container Return Scheme (BCRS).
settings.notAffiliated: This is an independent tool — not affiliated with NEA, the BCRS operator, or Return Right.
settings.bcrsInfoText1: From 1 April 2026, beverage producers in Singapore must register eligible containers (PET plastic, aluminium, steel; 150ml–3L) with a Deposit Mark.
settings.bcrsInfoText2: Consumers pay a 10-cent deposit at purchase and reclaim it by returning the container at a Return Right reverse vending machine.
settings.transitionPeriodText: 1 Apr – 30 Sep 2026. Not all products may carry the mark yet during this time.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.barcodeScanningDesc: Images from your camera are decoded entirely on your device. No photo or barcode image is ever uploaded to any server.
privacy.eligibilityChecksDesc: Your scanned barcodes are matched against a local database stored in your browser. The matching logic runs 100% on your device.
privacy.scanHistoryDesc: A short history of recent scans is kept locally so you can revisit results. You can delete this at any time.
privacy.databaseUpdatesDesc: The eligibility database is synced over HTTPS approximately once per day so you have the latest product registrations. No scan data is included in this request.
privacy.returnPointLocationsDesc: Nearby return machine data is fetched from the Return Right API when you open the "Nearby" tab. Your location is used only for distance sorting and is never stored on any server.
privacy.geolocationDesc: If you grant location permission, it is used solely to sort return points by distance. The permission request appears only when you tap the location button, with a clear explanation. You can decline and use postal code search instead.
privacy.noAccount: No account creation or login required.
privacy.noCookies: No cookies, fingerprinting, or cross-site tracking.
privacy.noAnalytics: No third-party analytics, advertising SDKs, or data brokers.
privacy.noDataSold: No barcode, photo, or location data is sold, shared, or used for profiling.
privacy.deleteLocalDataDesc: Use the button in Settings to erase all cached scan history and return point data from this device.
privacy.cameraPermissionDesc: Can be revoked at any time through your browser or OS settings. Manual barcode entry is always available as an alternative.
privacy.locationPermissionDesc: Can be revoked at any time. Postal code search works without it.
privacy.disclaimer: This app is an independent tool for checking BCRS eligibility. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to NEA Singapore, the BCRS operator, or Return Right.
